title: Pair a Label with Its Input
prompt:
Every input needs a label. Below is a lone input. Add a `label` element reading `Email address`, connect it to the input with `for`/`id`, and give the input a `name` of `email`.

Rules:
- The `label` comes first, wired with `for="email"`.
- The input has `id="email"` and `name="email"`.

tests.name: a label exists with the right text
tests.hint: <label for="email">Email address</label> — the text goes between the tags.

tests.name: label is wired to the input with for/id
tests.hint: for="email" on the label, id="email" on the input — the two values must match.

tests.name: input has a name for form submission
tests.hint: Controls without a name never send their value — add name="email".
